summary: Backend-only verification of the SUPPORT_HOURS .env quoting fix + regression smoke. Backend boots cleanly, GET /api/ returns 200, GET /api/support/config returns hours == '7j/7 · 6h–23h' with middle dot (·) and en-dash (–) intact. Regression: passenger login OK, /api/rides/estimate returns options, and moderator (chauffeur@test.com) receives 200 on /api/admin/integrations and /api/admin/dashboard. 6/6 pytest cases passed.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env: SUPPORT_HOURS is correctly quoted now ('7j/7 · 6h–23h'). Other unquoted values are ASCII-safe, no additional fixes needed.
routes/booking.py line 147 still has a Python default fallback matching the .env value ('7j/7 · 6h–23h') — good defense in depth if the env variable is stripped in future deploys.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused seeded test accounts passager@test.com and chauffeur@test.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SUPPORT_HOURS env fix verified. Endpoint returning hours is GET /api/support/config (public, no auth). Moderator emails are chauffeur@test.com and passager@test.com per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Login endpoint returns 'access_token'. /api/rides/estimate accepts POST with pickup/dropoff objects containing lat/lng/address.
rca_of_issue: Original blocker: backend/.env contained SUPPORT_HOURS=7j/7 · 6h–23h with spaces and non-ASCII characters unquoted, which breaks certain env parsers at deploy (python-dotenv tolerates it but many production loaders/K8s configmap converters do not). Fix: wrap value in double quotes. Verified end-to-end: env value is preserved bit-for-bit and served by /api/support/config.
